column1: # ThinkNode M5 multi-identity: single app slot + one LittleFS partition per
# identity (isolated stock storage paths) + a 'sys' partition for the
# composition's WiFi/web/admin prefs (kept separate so the repeater's inert
# stock NetworkService never picks up the composition's WiFi credentials).
# 4 MB flash. No OTA backup slot (flash over USB).
